recalibrated.was: struts detected by file extension; .md and .html could not count
recalibrated.now: the strut is declared, never derived — a commit says what it now does that it did not before
recalibrated.why: the extension rule was imported from a census of software repos into a project whose substance is language, and told the writer that writing is not work

recalibrated.was: repo = . — the gate read git at its own directory, which has no history
recalibrated.now: repo = ../../.. resolved against the gate directory by 01-motion, so the reading is the same wherever the shell stands
recalibrated.why: siting the gate inside the build made the motion window depend on cwd; a gate that reads a different repo depending on where it is invoked is an exhortation, not a filesystem fact

recalibrated.was: placeholder vocabulary shipped with the gate — intake, sounding, ground, deep, solid, standing, instruments
recalibrated.now: the twelve seats read off solid.js const SEATS, in its own order, asserted identical to solid.js NAMES
recalibrated.why: CLAUDE.md names solid.js the authority for every countable claim about the geometry; a second hand-maintained list of the seats would be the one object written down twice
